query: INSERT INTO nurse_shift_assignments (tenant_id, nurse_user_id, ward_id, shift_date, shift_type, patient_ids, primary_assigned, charge_nurse_user_id) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, COALESCE($4::date, CURRENT_DATE), $5::text, ARRAY[]::uuid[], COALESCE($6::bool, true), CASE WHEN COALESCE($7::bool, false) THEN $2::uuid ELSE NULL END) RETURNING id
